metadata.ion_limitations: Ground states only; ASD ionization energies are element-level and omit isotope shifts. Preserve estimated/theoretical flags. No missing-stage or A*u fallback.

hydrogen_affinity.reference: Lykke, Murray and Lineberger (1991), reported 0.754195(18) eV; DOI 10.1103/PhysRevA.43.6104

metadata.mass_mev_definition: Numerical mass in MeV/c^2, equal to rest-mass energy equivalent in MeV. uncertainty_mev is the larger absolute PDG error; both sides are also retained.

coverage.notes: Not all possible isotopes or charge states. Ionic masses are computed on demand. GUI species are a subset of the PDG section. No nuclear isomer masses; only H- among negative ions.
